In area 2 both found set-B J5 NOT_AUTHORED (L102). Under RC-26, VARTARGET's PER_OBJECTIVE_SET items cannot then entail tz-B, so L67/L72 ENTAILED is wrong in both. T6 at L157 was also judged without the V11 items that could make SD-20 yield. This untraced reader error comes from the area split in stage-d-inputs.js.
challenges.evidence: B1: 'If area 2 finds a set not entailed, that set's tz O1 lines become INVENTED'; L102 set-B J5 NOT_AUTHORED(DECLARED_GAP) (A and B); L67/L72 support only VARTARGET-01.a/02.a; A2: 'V11 items that might make SD-20 yield are not in this input'.

challenges.claim: The derivers worked independently from the grammar; the shared inputs did not decide hard cases.
challenges.challenge: The restater's designation map (BUILD_OUT_TEAM = 'T2 awardee (START: Team A)') made B's L79 reading possible and decided both area-1 P3 verdicts. The restater's glosses decided others. 'team defending that end (= NOT_LAST_TOUCH)' and 'ATTACKING_TEAM (= NOT_LAST_TOUCH)' were accepted (L130, L139 ENTAILED), against RC-22. The equally context-derived WON_BALL=ATTACKING_TEAM was rejected (L46/L47 INVENTED, 4 NEUTRAL items VIOLATED). Stage C candidates are row-level only.
challenges.evidence: game.json designationMap; A2 and B2 on RC-22: 'I accepted the game's stated equivalence'; register teamDesignations: 'Two designations are equal only if they map to one entry'; A1 and B1 on P6b: WON_BALL is a different entry (RC-22).

challenges.claim: The restatements are faithful enough that the derivation tests the grammar.
challenges.challenge: E1 found errors in the game restatement that decide verdicts. #55: the whole area as an S2 region (L6, L7, L9, L10 INVENTED). #61: neutrals encoded as consequences (L46, L47, L190-L192 INVENTED; NEUTRAL-03/14 VIOLATED). #66: an invented REGION_ENTRY transition was folded in and escaped the check. Zones belong on S2 (Â§5.2), not O1 (GF2-03/04/06 UNMET). A01-02 used an unregistered selector, restart=GOAL_KICK, so all 6 of its REQUIRED items are UNMET. Nothing was re-derived.

challenges.claim: Stage D shows that support can be derived mechanically when several contracts are combined.
challenges.challenge: The collision machinery was never exercised. Neither deriver found an UNRESOLVED line or recorded a collision on any line, and all 8 contracts together hold only 2 relationship rules. Would-be collisions disappeared because ENGINE_ONLY items are inert or because a PREFERRED_DEFAULT becomes ADAPTED (GF2-12.a/.b, GF2-17, VARTARGET-05.a). Nullifying A01-02 removed another source. SD-02, RC-27, RC-24 and relationship rules therefore have no agreement evidence.
challenges.evidence: comparison.json tallies (no UNRESOLVED); every collision field in derivations.json is 'none'; relationshipRules count is 1 each for RPC-001 and GF4 and 0 elsewhere; ADAPTED forward results: GF2-12.a, 12.b, 17, VARTARGET-05.a.

challenges.claim: Two blind contracts, drafted from the grammar alone, show that the grammar transfers.

They hold only 19 support-capable, non-ASSUMED items (PCG 10, GF4 9), and GF4's transition identity (OB1, OB4, REQUIRED) is all OUTSIDE_BOUNDARY. Neither was derived. Their context included the memory index line 'restarts unauthored in 11/11 Game Forms', which bears on GF4's T2-T5 NOT_AUTHORED declarations.

challenges.claim: S3: the blind contracts declare 81/81 rows.

PCG declares 13 rows, and GF4 about 19, only for elements that match a selector: PCG's O1 covers only kind=ball, and GF4's T2-T6 omit REGION_ENTRY, TIME_EXPIRY and STANDING. Other elements on those rows are undeclared. The derivers treated such silence as neither a bar nor a coverage gap, an unwritten rule that made L190-L197 INVENTED.

challenges.claim: The grammar of revision 4 is stable.

E1 added an RC-23 clarification (#38, verdict-changing), an RC-35 clarification (#41), a complement operator and new relative terms. At least 9 shared readings remain unwritten. About 45 rules so far, more at every stage. The verdict is about revision 4 plus conventions still being written, not revision 4 itself; the protocol says the count is part of the answer.

No pre-registered test calls a derivation-rule change LOCAL. G2 changes how a verdict is assigned and flips L157 for deriver B, so by protocol it goes to Christian. G1's fix brings in an episode scope (L-05), which Â§6 files as VOCABULARY, although it needs a new RC-23 unit-membership rule.

Both derivers gave it to the first-listed element, and that alone splits symmetric lines: L80 ENTAILED against L84 ASSUMED_ONLY, L85 ENTAILED against L89 NOT_AUTHORED, and set-A against set-B. 210 lines judged by both. Verdict agreement 208 (99.0%), verdict and reason 204 (97.1%), forward 162/166, kappa 0.983. The lead and an independent tracer each traced all 10 disagreements; none is untraced. 7 trace to four LOCAL gaps: designations, reason-code order, a needed unstated element, absent value forward. 3 are B's reader errors: L94, L157 (INVENTED), VARTARGET-13.d (VIOLATED). localAmendments.amendment: Handling of a stated value with no support. INVENTED if an ENTAILS source (item or citable SD) fixes a different value. Otherwise NOT_AUTHORED if a NOT_AUTHORED or UNDECLARED declaration reaches the element on any row, or an ASSUMED item fixes it under a reaching declaration. Otherwise INVENTED. Engine-only evidence names a reason, never the verdict.

Rule whether an element that no selector-scoped declaration on a declared row reaches is (a) silence, which neither bars nor is COVERAGE (both derivers' reading); (b) UNDECLARED; or (c) a drafting error, with a contract's declarations required to cover every element of a row.

localAmendments.amendment: RC-2: rule which elements a COUNT/RANGE minimum entails when more elements match than the minimum. Either the first N in the restated game's order (both derivers' unruled choice), or none individually, with every matching existence line judged as excess on a non-fillable row.
localAmendments.source: Critic (not listed by the lead or E1); A2 and B2 interpretations; cluster RC-2. Splits symmetric lines: L80/L84, L85/L89, L93/L102.

localAmendments.amendment: RC-35. A matched element with an absent value is UNMET if REQUIRED and SATISFIED if SUPPORTING or EXCLUSION. VIOLATED is only for a stated value that breaks the item. Labels in order: INERT, NOT_CHECKABLE, CLAUSE_CHECKED. When nothing matches: a REQUIRED FIELD or COLLECTION item is UNMET, PREFERRED_DEFAULT is ADAPTED or 'not used', others SATISFIED. ASSUMED items are checked as bounds.
localAmendments.source: Lead G4; E1 #41; RC-35 clusters; GF2-09.b ledger entry; independent trace: VARTARGET-05.b open, 13.d VIOLATED as written. Changes forward results (05.b, 13.d, 11.b, 05.a), not line verdicts.

A stated absence or empty collection is RESOLVED:ENTAILED, unless an item requires an element there or a NOT_AUTHORED or UNDECLARED declaration reaches the row.
localAmendments.source: Cluster 7; DV1 L111/L112 (both forced NOT_AUTHORED); L210 (both: 'no verdict fits', placeholder ENTAILED); L44.

localAmendments.source: Cluster 8; L119 (SD-14 START T7) and L204 (VARTARGET-13.d V21), where both derivers agreed without a rule.

judged.whatPreventsTheConclusion: Nothing, under the pre-registered criterion. Two rulings by Christian would reverse it. (1) RPC-001 must itself entail the carrier of its chosen event: that needs a guard, which is STRUCTURAL, so S1 fails (AM-25). (2) The new derivation reading rules count as Â§6's 'a change to how support is derived': then so would the 26 pre-run ones. AM-01 to AM-15 change verdicts and go to him first. Data-model design can start; the derivation engine should wait for his rulings.
judged.knowledgeGapsThatDoNotBlock: None count against stability. Unauthored: who restarts after out of play, a score or START (18 lines); which V1 event; which team attacks which end (J3); a second objective set (P-11); Variable Target's assignment keys, initial state, revelation, timing and holder; neutral and outfield counts; channel widths and target positions; 'goal kick', 'first defenders', 'own half'; Wide Zone's advantage form and size; GF4's asymmetry condition; 18 engine-only items.

Needed-but-unstated lines (L36, L100, L193) lacked a code. Unstated authored values (L119, L204) were ENTAILED by an unwritten reading (AM-08). Per-element units clash with RC-2 minimums (AM-05).

WON_BALL is not ATTACKING_TEAM, so L46/L47 are INVENTED. The glosses '(= NOT_LAST_TOUCH)' were accepted at L130/L139. Designations on static rows are unruled (AM-01).

The game leaves J9 unstated (L98), so fillability made no difference.
